name: MonarchButton
title: Icon button
summary: A square button that shows only an SF Symbol; the title is its VoiceOver name.
whenToUse: For a toolbar or row action that a symbol says well: close, more actions, refresh.
whenNotToUse: When the action needs a word to be understood use MonarchButton with a title and a symbol. Not for navigation bar items; leave those to the system.
api: MonarchButton.init(_ title: String, systemImage: String? = nil, variant: MonarchButtonVariant = .secondary, size: MonarchButtonSize = .md, isIconOnly: Bool = false, isLoading: Bool = false, action: @escaping () -> Void)

options.name: variant
options.description: primary, secondary, ghost or danger. Also dangerSubtle (a tinted destructive action), success (confirm, approve) and warning (an action that needs care).

options.name: size
options.description: sm (32), md (36) or lg (40) points high.

options.name: isIconOnly
options.description: Shows only systemImage on a square button; the title is still the spoken name. At least 44 by 44 points.

states.name: resting
states.description: The variant's fill, border and label colour.

states.name: pressed
states.description: A darker fill; not animated when Reduce Motion is on.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Muted fill and the disabled text colour, set with the standard disabled(_:) modifier.

states.name: loading
states.description: A spinner replaces the leading icon; the action does not run.

appearance: Primary uses the accent and danger the danger colour, in every theme. Secondary is a bordered surface and ghost has no fill until pressed. In the high-contrast themes the same roles resolve to stronger colours.
platformNotes: Icon-only is an option of MonarchButton, not a separate type. The visible square is 32 to 40 points and sits in a 44-point touch target.
accessibility: The title is the spoken name; the symbol is decoration.
The touch target is at least 44 by 44 points.
edgeCases: Without a systemImage the title is drawn, so an icon-only button always passes a symbol.
